title: OMC codec configuration (control-plane API contract)
description: Machine-readable mirror of omc_validate_config() in src/config.c - the C function is the authority; this schema exists for app-side pre-validation and UI generation. Measured guidance for every knob: docs/CONTROL_PLANE.md.

width.description: TRUE picture width (v4.2: any value; non-aligned widths pad-and-crop automatically, <1% rate cost)

height.description: TRUE picture height (v4.2: any value; pad-and-crop)

source_format.description: rgb: planar R,G,B in/out via lossless RCT (components <= 10-bit, 4:4:4, container promoted +2 - BITSTREAM.md sec 8); mono: single plane (key/alpha), flat-chroma convention, ~0.3% overhead

rate.description: Exactly one of bpp or mbps; app converts for display

refresh_frames.description: Loss-recovery window R in frames; 0 = default (8); 1 = stateless (no frame store, XS-architecture parity). Measured cost table: CONTROL_PLANE.md section 3

mode.description: perception = grain fill on (eye-judged services); fidelity = --no-fill (metric-gated contracts). REPORT 12f

scan.description: progressive only; interlace deferred by product decision (design retained in docs/INTERLACE_CONVENTION.md)

deadzone.description: v4.4 detail-band deadzone (9/16 zero zone, bands 4-9; reconstruction points unchanged). Auto-disabled under tune=vmaf. Measured +0.45 dB all planes at 2.0 bpp. ENHANCEMENTS_LEDGER E-3

grain_replace.description: v4.4 two-vote invisible-grain classifier (scale support + temporal persistence, inter slices only; |q|=1 demotions only, fill-regenerated). ~15-17% rate at equal VMAF on electronic noise, ~4-5% on coarse film grain; DEFAULT OFF pending the rev.6 blind-viewing gate. ENHANCEMENTS_LEDGER E-5

fill_static.description: v4.7 static grain-fill tile (bitstream minor 7): grain-fill sign-tile offsets frame-independent (static grain texture, no temporal animation). BITSTREAM.md sec 9.5, ENHANCEMENTS_LEDGER E-10

block_mv.description: v4.3 per-block motion field (bitstream minor 3). Measured ~0 dB on the delivery corpus; capability retained for future motion work. ENHANCEMENTS_LEDGER E-6

mv_regions.description: single-hop links only; multi-hop chains reconverge instead of byte-replaying (DESIGN.md 1b)

lossless.description: lossless-preferred: bit-exact per frame when it fits the CBR budget, graceful lossy fallback otherwise (still exact-CBR); implies no fill; pair with a high bpp (>=10 grain, >=3 clean). REPORT 14
